advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Constrain `shared_side` to a validated set (Literal['first','second'] or an explicit guard) so an unexpected value fails loudly instead of silently double-sending the query digest and misaligning the FIRST/SECOND slots.
evidence: judge.py:52-59: `_hoisted_system_prompt` uses `first if shared_side == "first" else second` and `_pair_instructions` uses `... if shared_side == "first" else ...` / `... if shared_side == "second" else ...`
judge.py:98-101: `if shared_side is not None: system_prompt = _hoisted_system_prompt(system_prompt, first if shared_side == "first" else second)`
ABSENCE: no assertion/guard that shared_side is one of {None,'first','second'}; both current callers pass literals so it is latent, not live
advisory.finding: `shared_side` is a stringly-typed internal contract with no validation: _hoisted_system_prompt hoists via `first if shared_side == 'first' else second`, while _pair_instructions substitutes the reference only on exact 'first'/'second' matches. Any other non-None value (e.g. a mis-cased 'First' or a typo) would both hoist a digest into the system prompt AND emit both full digest blocks inline, silently double-sending and misaligning the FIRST/SECOND slots — the opposite of the change's intent — without raising.
advisory.suggested_fix: Type the parameter as `Literal["first", "second"] | None` and/or add an explicit `assert shared_side in (None, "first", "second")` before the hoist so an out-of-set value fails fast rather than corrupting the request bytes.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add an assertion that the hoisted system prompt contains `_SHARED_DIGEST_HEADER` (and that the default/un-hoisted path does NOT), so dropping the orientation header fails a test.
evidence: test asserts only the block: tests/unit/test_overlap_judge.py:327 `assert query_block in systems.pop()` — no assertion on `_SHARED_DIGEST_HEADER`

ABSENCE: `_SHARED_DIGEST_HEADER` is never imported or referenced in tests (search over tests returned no matches), so the header's presence/position is unverified while the whole hoist correctness depends on it
advisory.finding: No test asserts the hoisted system prompt contains the orientation header (`_SHARED_DIGEST_HEADER`) that tells the model the hoisted digest is one of FIRST/SECOND. The new tests only assert the query DIGEST BLOCK is present in the system prompt; removing or corrupting the header — a behavior-changing regression this diff introduces, and the sole thing that makes the hoisted digest interpretable in its FIRST/SECOND slot — would leave all four new tests passing.
advisory.suggested_fix: In `test_shared_query_digest_lives_only_in_the_system_prompt`, after `sys = systems.pop()`, add `assert _SHARED_DIGEST_HEADER in sys`; and in `test_judge_one_default_shape_is_unchanged` add `assert _SHARED_DIGEST_HEADER not in req.system_prompt` (importing `_SHARED_DIGEST_HEADER).
